test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting in a straight row, facing north. H is second to the right of G. F and K are immediate neighbours. Both F and E are immediate neighbours of I. H and E are immediate neighbours. K is at the extreme right end of the row. J is at the immediate left of H. Who is at the immediate left of J?
solution:
Given, E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

K is at the extreme right end of the row.

F and K are immediate neighbours.

Both F and E are immediate neighbours of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c8fd6f1fcdc4114582ee416c3c64743df9d7afc674b014f5ebf0b37f072d976.png] 

H and E are immediate neighbours.

H is second to the right of G.

J is at the immediate left of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abbf044aecb1d489316aed99d330c4e93dc650406468cfc0175e55e5ba852713.png] 

G is at the immediate left of J.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
